sentences.en: All of a sudden, the barn went up in flames.
The eternal flame of love burned only half a year.
sentences.zh: 爱情之火只燃烧了一年半载。

sentences.en: The firefighters are trying to bring the flames under control.
sentences.zh: 消防员们正试图控制住火焰。

senses.zh: 火焰，火舌，鲜红色，光辉，恋人，怀念，辱骂信息，热情
焚烧，爆发，面红，发辱骂信息
